title: legionctl config
description: The controller document this machine is holding, its hash, and who wrote it. `raw` is the stored text, exactly the canonical bytes `hash` covers, and is what a client hashes and adopts; `controller` is the same document parsed, kept for older clients. Agents before 3.1.0 send no `raw`.

allOf.description: There is stored text exactly when there is a stored document.

raw.description: The stored document as text: the canonical bytes of v3.md section 12, at most 1 MiB of UTF-8, null exactly when `controller` is null. Hash and adopt this; never re-serialise `controller`.

bytes.description: The UTF-8 length of `raw`, 0 when it is null.

error.description: Set when a file is there and could not be read. The hash is still reported, so the authority pushes over it instead of leaving it to sit there.
